caption:
You can quote every verse about Him. But have you ever met Him? Freedom doesn't start with what you know — it starts with what He already did. (Galatians 1:3-5 devotional)

The gospel doesn't begin with how much you know about Jesus — it begins with what He already did. Before you ever looked up, He gave Himself for your sins to rescue you out of this present evil age. You were never climbing up to reach Him; He reached down and grabbed the hand that couldn't hold on.
